name: assistloop
description: AssistLoop gives your business an AI support agent that answers customers on your website, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram and email, and gets things done for them, like booking appointments, checking orders and updating their details. With this plugin, your team runs it all from ChatGPT: reply to customers, manage support tickets, and teach your AI agent what it needs to know.

interface.longDescription:
AssistLoop gives your business an AI support agent. It answers your customers on your website, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram and email, and passes the conversation to a person on your team when one is needed.

It doesn't stop at answers. Connect AssistLoop to the tools your business already runs on, and your AI agent can get things done for your customers right in the conversation: book or move an appointment, check on an order or delivery, update their details, or open a request. You decide exactly what it is allowed to do. It also collects leads, shares your Calendly booking link and adds tickets to HubSpot.

With this plugin, your team can run all of that from ChatGPT:
- Conversations: see what customers are asking, reply to them, hand a chat to your team or back to the AI agent, or close it.
- Support tickets: see, create and update tickets, leave notes for your team, and email the customer.
- Training: teach your AI agent from text, questions and answers, or pages from your website, and see when it has learned them.
- Settings: rename an agent, choose its AI model, update its instructions, and decide when chats go to a person.

Who it is for: owners, admins and members of an AssistLoop workspace. You sign in with your AssistLoop account and approve the connection, and you only see what you can see in AssistLoop. Members only see the agents they are assigned to.

Good to know: the plugin cannot delete anything, create new agents, upload files, or connect your other tools; you do those in AssistLoop. Replies and emails reach real customers, so the plugin is set up to send only text you wrote or approved. Requires an AssistLoop account. Privacy: https://assistloop.ai/legal/privacy
capabilities: Read and reply to customer conversations
Hand chats between your AI agent and your team
Manage support tickets and email customers
Teach your AI agent from text, Q&A and web pages
See when your AI agent has finished learning
Change your AI agent's name, model and instructions
defaultPrompt: Show the open high-priority tickets for my support agent.
Summarize the conversations my support agent had today.
Add a Q&A to my support agent about our refund policy.

positive.prompt: Which open tickets on my Support agent are high priority?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 11 open high-priority tickets of Support agent in Northwind Coffee, including 'iOS push notifications stopped overnight' and 'Webhook retries are storming our endpoint'. In-progress, resolved and closed tickets are not listed.

positive.description: Read and summarize a customer conversation
positive.prompt: What does Lena Park need in her conversation with the Support agent?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Lena Park's open conversation and summarizes it: order TH-8831 arrived in the wrong color (white instead of walnut), she wants a replacement before Saturday and asked a teammate to confirm warehouse stock.

positive.description: Reply to a customer with the text the user gave
positive.prompt: Reply to Lena Park: Thanks Lena, a walnut replacement ships today and arrives Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the reply exactly as written, without a draft step (ChatGPT may ask to confirm first, depending on the user's settings). The tool returns the stored message with the reply text; get_conversation then shows response_mode human, so the AI stops answering that conversation.

positive.prompt: Assign the ticket 'Add a dark theme for the dashboard' to me and set its priority to medium.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the ticket (ChatGPT asks to confirm first unless the user allows such changes without asking). The returned ticket shows the reviewer (ChatGPT Reviewer) as assignee and priority medium; the status stays open.

positive.description: Train the agent with a Q&A and check its progress
positive.prompt: Teach my Support agent: question 'Do you ship outside the EU?', answer 'Yes, to the UK and Switzerland within 5 working days.' Then check whether it is trained.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the Q&A source and says training runs in the background. get_training_status reports the new source as training or trained; it never claims training finished before the status says so.

negative.description: Deleting an agent is not supported

negative.prompt: Show me the support tickets of another company that uses AssistLoop.

negative.description: Billing and plan changes are not supported
negative.prompt: Upgrade my AssistLoop workspace to a bigger plan and charge my card.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: conversations, tickets, training and agent settings for AssistLoop workspaces, with five workflow skills (Get started, Ticket Triage, Customer Conversations, Agent Training, Agent Settings).
